parameters.content:
# GitHub review drafts

Website authentication and Gemini are assigned.
AI image quota is currently 0; Browserless is not configured.

Current mode imports public repository metadata and GitHub preview covers as review drafts. Missing AI artwork is explicitly marked unavailable, which blocks publication. Real screenshots remain unavailable until configured.

No changed revision is imported twice. No Facebook or Instagram publishing occurs.

Before enabling artwork or screenshots, configure provider credentials, use public cover-image storage (never the private Instagram store), update the pipelineVersion, and test manually. Keep exactly one scheduler active.

## Processing rules

Checks hourly. Processes at most 3 changed public repositories per run.

Skips empty, private, forked, archived and disabled repositories.

Reuses existing website categories and live links.

Black + #98FF02 cover is conceptual artwork. Screenshots are actual website captures.

No live URL: upload a cover and dashboard draft without a screenshot.

Provider errors stop the run. Failed attempts may repeat generation and charges on a later run.

Keep only ONE scheduler active. Do not overlap manual and scheduled runs.
